items.title: Hopper’s Co-Founder and B2B Boss Left The Company
items.summary: One source said Dakota Smith had a lot of credibility in the B2B space, Hopper's most important division.

items.title: Hilton Isn’t ‘Blocking’ New AI Agents. But They Can’t Always Get In.
items.summary: Hilton's CEO says he wants to make booking through AI agents easy. For now, Meta's Muse struggles to pull a price from hotel group sites, and OTAs may remain an easier door.

items.title: How the Tourist Became the Taxpayer of Last Resort
items.summary: Tourist taxes are usually sold as a way to manage crowds. Their deeper appeal is political: They raise money from people who cannot vote against the officials spending it.

items.title: Thai Airways CEO Says He Was Pushed Out Due to Bangkok Flood Chaos
items.summary: Thai Airways emerged from years of restructuring with ambitious plans to expand its fleet and international network. A flood-driven operational breakdown at its Bangkok hub has now cost its CEO his job.

items.title: What Does It Take to Get Travel AI Out of the Pilot Stage?
items.summary: A pilot can demonstrate that AI performs a task. Putting it into a travel business requires someone to own the results, handle the exceptions and show that it is worth the cost.

items.title: Airline Wi-Fi Has a Lie-Flat Seat Problem
items.summary: United has a real lead with Starlink and is smart to make as much noise about it as possible. Travel history suggests the lead won't last nearly as long as the enthusiasm around it.

items.title: ‘The P&L Doesn’t Lie’: Hotels See More AI Costs Than Bottom-Line Gains
items.summary: Hotel tech investments keep climbing, but profits aren't keeping pace. Can hotels promise that AI will mean no job cuts and a payoff on the P&L at the same time?

items.title: No Starlink? United Airlines Targets Rivals With Status Match Offer
items.summary: United is betting that Starlink will become one of its biggest selling points as it ramps up rollout of the in-flight Wi-Fi. Meanwhile, its chief rival, Delta, is receiving pushback online for not choosing the internet provider.
